name: Simplified Plugin
author: kodeshpa

sections.description:
Simplified is the one app to create, collaborate, and scale your marketing.
Design, write marketing copy, create videos, collaborate, and publish to socials—all in the same place.

Publish content directly from Simplified.com to your WordPress.
sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  2. Search for ‘Simplified’
  3. Click ‘Install Now’
  4. Activate the plugin on the Plugin dashboard
  5. In Simplified, go to Social Media and connect your WordPress account to get the API token
  6. Go to plugin settings (Settings → Simplified) and paste the API token

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  2. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  3. Select simplifiedplugin.zip from your computer
  4. Click ‘Install Now’
  5. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard
  6. In Simplified, go to Social Media and connect your WordPress account to get the API token
  7. Go to plugin settings (Settings → Simplified) and paste the API token
sections.faq:
What can I do with this plugin?

You can simply publish your AI generated content from Simplified to your WordPress blog
sections.changelog:
1.0.15

  • Improved: settings page explains where to find the API token (Simplified → Social Media → connect WordPress account)
  • New: connection status on the settings page showing the last activity from Simplified
  • New: admin notice on the dashboard and plugins screens when the API token is missing

1.0.14

  • Fixed: body images with signed URLs (query string with “&”) were not imported to the media library
  • Fixed: posts published on sites west of UTC were stored as scheduled instead of published
  • New: optional excerpt parameter in publish endpoint
  • New: optional status parameter in publish endpoint (publish, draft, pending, private)
  • New: publish endpoint returns status, link and failed_images
  • New: verify endpoint returns plugin version

1.0.13

  • New: GET simplified/v1/posts — list posts with filters (status, search, pagination, categories, tags, dates)
  • New: GET simplified/v1/posts/{id} — fetch single post with raw + rendered content

1.0.12

  • Fixed image upload support for URLs without file extensions (e.g., Unsplash images)
  • Improved image type detection based on file content instead of URL

1.0.11

  • Added optional author_id parameter to publish endpoint
  • Added optional tags parameter to publish endpoint (supports both tag IDs and tag names)
  • Added new GET /users endpoint to retrieve WordPress users with filtering options
  • Added new GET /tags endpoint to retrieve WordPress tags with filtering options
  • Fixed bug with post_type parameter assignment
  • Improved parameter validation and sanitization
  • Enhanced security with author existence validation

1.0.10

  • fixed images support

1.0.9

  • added uploading images from content

1.0.8

  • bug fixes and improvements

1.0.7

  • bug fixes and improvements

1.0.6

  • added post_types endpoint

1.0.5

  • added categories endpoint
  • added support for slug
  • added support for featured image
  • added support for categories

1.0.4

  • Tested on 6.4 version

1.0.3

  • Fixed html issue

1.0.2

  • Added new verification if plugin is installed method

1.0.0
